purpose: Determine whether the seven blinded reads marked MINOR for completeness were already thin in their approved writer inputs or were flattened by the frozen v4 writer.

review_dimensions.diagnostic_question: Was the frozen approved input already limited to a single observation, or did the writer lose a separately approved action or richer supported idea?

findings.neutral_situation: A tool used for a regular task changes how the task works.
findings.plain_insight: When a tool changes, you may jump in before you understand how it works.
findings.accepted_title: Learn It Before You Use It
findings.accepted_read: When a tool changes, you may start using it before you understand how it works.
findings.preservation: Near-verbatim; jump in became start using without adding or removing a supported action or consequence.
findings.conclusion: The approved input supplied one observation and no action. The writer did not flatten a richer approved thought.

findings.neutral_situation: A new invitation becomes available while an existing commitment remains in place.
findings.plain_insight: When a new invitation comes up, you may make a quick choice before thinking through plans you already have.
findings.accepted_read: When a new invitation comes up, you may say yes or no before you think through the plans you already have.
findings.preservation: Meaning-preserving paraphrase; the input contained no separately approved action or second supported beat.
findings.conclusion: The read is limited by the one-beat approved input, not by loss of richer input during writing.

findings.neutral_situation: A group is making plans, and one important detail remains open.
findings.plain_insight: When friends are making plans, you may keep your answer open instead of committing.
findings.accepted_read: When friends are making plans, you may keep your answer open instead of committing.
findings.conclusion: The writer preserved the entire approved input exactly; no richer approved material existed for it to express.

findings.neutral_situation: An evening opens up after a busy day.
findings.plain_insight: When your evening opens up, you may find it hard to slow down.
findings.accepted_read: When your evening opens up, you may find it hard to slow down.
findings.conclusion: The output is exactly the approved one-sentence input, so the generic or incomplete feeling originates upstream.

findings.neutral_situation: Something used in a shared space stops working and needs replacement.
findings.plain_insight: When something shared stops working, you may focus on getting the home working smoothly again.
findings.accepted_read: When something shared at home stops working, you may focus on getting the home working smoothly again.
findings.preservation: Near-verbatim; shared became shared at home.
findings.conclusion: The circularity was already present in the narrow approved input. The writer neither removed an action nor lost a richer supported tension.

findings.neutral_situation: A plan shared with someone close changes.
findings.plain_insight: When a shared plan changes, you may keep what you think about it to yourself.
findings.accepted_read: When a shared plan changes, you may keep your thoughts about it to yourself.
findings.preservation: Near-verbatim; what you think became your thoughts.
findings.conclusion: The approved input contains only the observation. The writer did not omit an approved consequence, action, or second beat.

findings.neutral_situation: A plan shared with someone close changes.
findings.plain_insight: When a shared plan changes, you may notice quickly if it no longer feels balanced.
findings.accepted_read: When a shared plan changes, you may notice right away that it no longer feels balanced.
findings.conclusion: The writer faithfully preserved the narrow approved observation; no separately approved action or consequence was available to make it feel more complete.

aggregate_conclusion.finding: Every read marked MINOR for completeness faithfully preserved a one-beat frozen input with no separately approved action, consequence, or second supported idea.

scope_guard.recommended_next_step: Review upstream insight depth and evidence support before any new paid cohort. Do not retune or regenerate the frozen writer cohort.
